progression.narrative: The performance opens on F4 and dwells most on F in Abolchap. The line peaks at Bb4 (453.3 Hz) at 0:29.1. It closes on the tonic (Dk4 → Dk4 → F4 → E4 → E4 → F4).

flags: tonic F set in the catalog (the Rast-Panjgah suite's finalis F: Daramad II and ten gushe-ha end on it; read from it the suite has Rast's leading tone (the 2nd below, 4% of played time), which the other candidate, its 5th C, lacks (0.3%); Farhat 1990, pp. 100-101. Borumand's Nava on the same volume sits a tone above it, as in Farhat's keys; the vote picked the 5th. Inference, not yet by ear); the runs' vote favoured 255.1 Hz (C)
